extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: T: V → W satisfying T(u+v)=T(u)+T(v) and T(cu)=cT(u)

extracted_concepts.name: Additivity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v)

extracted_concepts.name: Homogeneity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: T(cu) = cT(u) for scalar c

extracted_concepts.name: Kernel
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ker(T) = {v ∈ V : T(v) = 0}

extracted_concepts.name: Image
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Im(T) = {T(v) : v ∈ V}, the column space

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dim(Ker T) + dim(Im T) = dim(V)

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Representation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: [T(v)]_B = A[v]_B for fixed bases of V and W

extracted_concepts.name: Composition of Transformations

extracted_concepts.name: Transition Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P satisfying [x]_B = P[x]_B'

extracted_concepts.name: Similarity Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix of T in new basis: A' = P⁻¹AP

extracted_concepts.name: Inner Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ⟨u, v⟩ = u₁v₁ + ... + uₙvₙ in Rⁿ, generalized to abstract spaces

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard inner product on Rⁿ

extracted_concepts.name: Linearity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inner product is linear in each argument

extracted_concepts.name: Positive Definiteness
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ⟨v, v⟩ ≥ 0 with equality only for v = 0

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vectors are orthogonal if ⟨u, v⟩ = 0

extracted_concepts.name: Gram-Schmidt Process
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Converts any basis to an orthonormal basis

extracted_concepts.name: Orthonormal Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Basis of mutually orthogonal unit vectors {qᵢ}

extracted_concepts.name: Least Squares
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Best approximate solution to Ax = b

extracted_concepts.name: Normal Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x̂ = (A^T A)⁻¹ A^T b

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Proj_W v = Σᵢ ⟨v, qᵢ⟩qᵢ for orthonormal basis {qᵢ} of W
